ana (security): Heads-up — CustomerCorp sent an updated evidence request. They now require per-request audit events that include KMS key_id, RBAC decision attributes, and a token-cost estimate. They want delivery within an operational SLA and a verifiable bundle we can sign. cc @mike (product) @paul (legal)

mike (product): Got it. Can you paste the exact fields they expect? Any sample?

jess (eng-ml): We need to think runtime perf here. Per-request events with kv cache state + model metadata could be large. Also watch PII in inputs. Sampling might be required for high-throughput routes.

ana (security): Pasted their minimal schema snippet below (redacted):
```json
{
  "event_id": "string",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "request_id": "string",
  "user_id": "sha256(user_id)",
  "action": "string",
  "resource": "string",
  "rbac_decision": { "policy": "string", "result": "allow|deny", "reason": "string" },
  "kms_key_id": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "input_truncated": true,
  "error_code": "optional",
  "cost_tokens": { "input": 123, "output": 456 },
  "schema_version": "string"
}
```

paul (legal): From a contracts perspective we need: retention periods, export format, whether the event bundle is considered customer data, and whether signature/attestation suffices for FedRAMP-like audits. Also HIPAA customers will want BAAs and a de-id guarantee for PHI in logs.

jess (eng-ml): Two technical asks: 1) schema_version is mandatory for forward compatibility, 2) we need a compact mode where large text inputs are redacted and replaced with a hash + length to avoid leaking PII and to stay within event size budgets.

ana (security): Proposal: default full events for enterprise plans that opt-in, sampling for free tier. Retention default 90 days for full payloads, 24 months for metadata-only; legal can override for SOC2/FedRAMP customers. Events delivered via a push webhook or pulled as a signed bundle.

mike (product): For the customer-facing validator: we should provide an endpoint + reference client that validates a signed bundle. Signed bundle = manifest + gz archive + signature header. Use KMS to sign server side and expose verification key. Customers can validate integrity locally.

ana (security): Example manifest idea:
```
manifest: {
  "bundle_id": "uuid",
  "schema_version": "v1.0",
  "event_count": 12000,
  "generated_at": "iso8601",
  "signature": "base64",
  "sig_alg": "RS256-KMS"
}
```

paul (legal): That signature approach is reasonable. We need to define SLA language for delivery: max time-to-deliver for push = 5s (hosted), fallback window for pull = 24h, and an incident escalation if delivery fails for more than X minutes. Also need to price for long-term storage / egress.

jess (eng-ml): Implementation concerns: realtime streaming of events to external webhooks at 5s latency will increase tail latency and extra I/O. Suggest async buffering: write to internal kafka/topic, ack request quickly, then deliver events to webhooks. That gives us backpressure protection. Also track per-route event rate to avoid bursts.

ana (security): We also need to version audit schema in our docs and add a migration plan for customers when we bump fields. Add a validation service that can run customers' sample events against the current schema and return diffs.

mike (product): Action items: 1) define final schema + redaction rules (owner: ana), 2) design delivery patterns + SLA doc (owner: jess), 3) validator + signing spec (owner: eng-platform, tentative: jess), 4) contract language draft for retention/SLA/pricing (owner: paul). Can we target a mini-PRD by EOD Friday?

paul (legal): I'll draft sample contract clauses for retention, attestations, and incident remedies. Note: FedRAMP-like asks may require us to accept CDAs around control evidence — will escalate if customers make that a hard requirement.

ana (security): One more: vuln/incident implication — if an incident causes failure to generate/ship events we need to mark the window in the bundle metadata (e.g., "missing_ranges": [ {"from":"ts","to":"ts","reason":"incident-123"} ]). Customers will demand transparency.

sre-bot: deploy-notice: audit-schema/v1.0 branch builds passing in CI, staging deploy queued. :rocket:

jess (eng-ml): I'll prototype redaction + compact mode by Tuesday. Ana — can you collect the different customer retention asks (SOC2/SOC2 Type 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP) and post here?

ana (security): Will do. Final note: keep schema minimal by default; allow enterprise toggles. We'll reconvene after PRD draft. :white_check_mark:
